messages:
maria_ng: FYI opening a quota request for a customer private GCP project (acme-pvt-eu1). Need 8 x A100 80GB (with NVLink) in europe-west4 + 50 reserved internal IPs and 3x increased forwarding rule quota. This is to run a Redwood Private POC (batch infer) — steady ~400 qps, peaks ~1200. Created internal support ticket 1234567890. Can someone pick up escalation with GCP premium?

sam_k: Got it. Do we have the GCP project number and exact quota names? GCP divides GPU quotas by SKU/region (e.g., NVIDIA_A100_80GB: europe-west4). Also need to know if they want Zonal vs Regional quota.

maria_ng: Project number: 987654321012. They specifically requested NVLink-enabled nodes (a2-family or custom A100 NVLink). Prefer non-preemptible. Quota names we need: `NVIDIA_A100_80GB` (regional), `INTERNAL_ADDRESSES` (regional), `FORWARDING_RULES` (global).

ashley_ops: Heads-up on cost — 8x A100-80GB non-preemptible will be ~+$70k/mo raw. Recommend we propose a staged rollout: 2 nodes for initial soak, then scale to 8 after traffic validation. Also suggest quantized model path as fallback so we can run on 4x smaller GPUs if quota takes longer. :thinking:

tyler_infra: I'll coordinate the escalation. Opened case with GCP on our side — case number 220123456 (GCP internal). Linking the provider thread: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/220123456 (customer must be on enterprise support to escalate).

gcp_support_bot: Case 220123456 updated: initial quota review complete. Additional verification required for NVLink capability in europe-west4. Agent assigned: gcp-rep-eu. ETA for capacity validation: 5 business days.

maria_ng: Thanks. Can you also ask them to check the per-project vCPU and endpoint NAT port quotas — we saw failures when provisioning >20 instances in our staging cluster (errors: `PORTS_EXHAUSTED`). Sample error logs attached to ticket 1234567890.

sam_k: For the provisioning runbook, here's the command we used in staging:```bash
gcloud compute instances create inference-a100-1 \
  --zone=europe-west4-a \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-32 \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100-80gb,count=1 \
  --maintenance-policy=TERMINATE \
  --metadata=enable-nvidia-driver-installation=TRUE
```We should paste this into the case so they can repro.

gcp_support_rep: Hi team — I'm the assigned engineer on case 220123456. Verified quota buckets. NVLink-capable A100s in europe-west4 require quota in the GPU SKU and availability is constrained in some zones. We can request a regional allocation but physical capacity needs confirmation from capacity team. I've escalated to capacity ops. Current ETA: 7 business days for confirmation. For INTERNAL_ADDRESSES and FORWARDING_RULES, we can usually increase within 1-2 business days once we have justification.

ashley_ops: If they can't guarantee NVLink nodes in the requested zone, we should ask for priority placement in any europe-west4 zone (a/b/c) or fallback to europe-west3. Also ask about inter-zone NVLink implications (if any).

maria_ng: Added a short justification to both cases: POC for regulated customer, will run within VPC with strict isolation, SLA target <120ms tail latency for single-token generation, need NVLink to meet memory and latency needs. Please include cost/commitment questions in the thread (they asked if we want committed use discounts).

tyler_infra: Update: I put in a temporary capacity ticket to request smaller A100s (4x) as hot-standby nodes if full 8x A100s can't be provisioned in time. That buys us a week or two. Also created internal task INFRA-3421 to track this.

gcp_support_bot: Customer case 1234567890 (linked) updated by GCP partner team: Added request to increase `INTERNAL_ADDRESSES` by 50, `FORWARDING_RULES` by 3. Action: quota increases queued, pending verification of project billing and organization limits. Expected completion: 2 business days after org verification.

gcp_support_rep: Quick note — to speed up NVLink availability we can flag this as a capacity-critical request but that requires customer contact + business justification (looks like you've added that). If you want me to request priority, reply `+PRIORITY` in this thread and I'll pass it to the ops queue.

maria_ng: +PRIORITY — please escalate. Also confirm if we need to provide a dedicated contact (phone/email) on the customer side for the escalation.

gcp_support_rep: Received +PRIORITY. Please provide a customer-verified contact email and phone in the case comments. I'll mark the case urgent and follow up within 24 hours.

sam_k: I'll reach out to the customer and get the contact. Meanwhile I'll paste the gcloud snippet and error traces into both cases. Anything else we should attach?

maria_ng: Attach deployment manifest, expected traffic profile (CSV), and the perf-eval results showing memory usage per shard. Also note fallback quantization plans.

ashley_ops: Keep me in the loop on cost + CU commitments. We may want to negotiate a short-term committed use discount if they're okay with it.

tyler_infra: I'll watch the case and post updates here. If GCP confirms less than 8 NVLink nodes, we'll move to the staged plan and re-run capacity tests.

maria_ng: Great — thanks everyone. Logging this thread into INFRA-3421 so ops can pick up next steps.

(automated): Thread archived to infra-projects after 30d of inactivity.
